name: Trattoria Vecchia
description: Small family-run Italian place with handmade pasta
reviews: Super cozy and intimate, felt like eating in someone's Italian grandmother's dining room
The carbonara was incredible, best I've had outside of Rome
Quiet enough to have a real conversation, perfect for our anniversary
Handmade pasta is the star here, you can taste the difference
Small place so make a reservation, only about 10 tables
The tiramisu is homemade and amazing

name: Golden Dragon Kitchen
description: Bustling dim sum and Cantonese spot, big round tables
reviews: Best dim sum in the city, the har gow are perfect
Great for big family gatherings, we had 12 people and they handled it easily
Loud and chaotic but that's part of the charm
Kids loved the fried rice and dumplings
Weekend brunch dim sum is the move, get there early though
Portions are huge, we always have leftovers

name: The Green Plate
description: Farm-to-table seasonal menu, minimalist clean decor
reviews: Beautiful plating, every dish looks like art
The seasonal tasting menu was worth every penny, 7 courses for 2
Very quiet and upscale, not the place for loud groups
Menu changes every few weeks based on what's fresh
Great wine pairings recommended by the sommelier
Perfect date night spot, romantic lighting and great service

name: Sakura Sushi
description: Omakase counter and regular tables, minimalist Japanese interior
reviews: The omakase was a 12-course experience, absolutely worth it
Sitting at the counter watching the chef work is half the experience
Very calm and peaceful atmosphere, soft music in the background
Fish is incredibly fresh, they get deliveries daily
Not great for kids, it's very quiet and formal
The sake selection is excellent, staff really knows their stuff

name: Big Tony's Pizzeria
description: No-frills New York style pizza joint with a few tables
reviews: Best cheap pizza in the neighborhood, huge slices
Nothing fancy but the pizza is legit, crispy thin crust
My kids beg to come here every weekend
Great for a quick bite, in and out in 20 minutes
The pepperoni slice is iconic, grease dripping and all
Cash only which is annoying but the pizza makes up for it
Perfect late night food spot, open until 2am

name: Jardin Provencal
description: Elegant French dining with garden courtyard seating
reviews: The garden courtyard is magical in the evening with string lights
Felt like being transported to the south of France
We did the 5-course prix fixe for our anniversary, unforgettable
Sommelier paired every course perfectly, worth the splurge
Dress code is smart casual, not the place for jeans and sneakers
The duck confit is the best dish on the menu, order it
Service was impeccable, attentive without being intrusive

name: Mama Rosa's Kitchen
description: Colorful family-owned taqueria with a small patio
reviews: Most authentic tacos I've found in this city, the al pastor is incredible
Super family friendly, they even have a little coloring station for kids
The salsa bar has like 8 different salsas, all homemade
Loud and lively, mariachi band on Friday nights
Huge portions for the price, the burrito could feed two people
Love the outdoor patio on warm days, very casual vibe
Horchata is homemade and the best I've ever had

name: The Copper Bar & Grill
description: Industrial-chic gastropub with craft cocktails and elevated bar food
reviews: Great spot for after-work drinks with colleagues
The smash burger is unreal, best burger in the harbor area
Cool industrial decor, exposed brick and copper pipes everywhere
Gets really loud on Friday and Saturday nights
Good for groups, we had a birthday party of 8 and it worked perfectly
Cocktail menu is creative, the bartenders really know their stuff
Not romantic at all but perfect for a fun casual night out

name: Naan & Curry House
description: No-frills Indian spot popular with students, big portions
reviews: Best butter chicken in the city and it's only 12 dollars
The lunch buffet is an insane deal, all you can eat for 10 bucks
Not fancy at all but the food is absolutely authentic
Great for vegetarians, tons of options unlike most places
Naan bread is fresh out of the tandoor, you can watch them make it
Can get crowded during lunch rush since it's near the university
Spice levels are legit, when they say hot they mean HOT

name: Blue Harbor Seafood
description: Upscale seafood with floor-to-ceiling harbor views
reviews: The view alone is worth the visit, floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the harbor
Lobster roll was perfectly done, generous chunks of fresh lobster
Great spot for a special occasion, we celebrated our engagement here
Sunday brunch with the waterfront view is incredible
The raw bar is excellent, oysters were super fresh
A bit pricey but the quality matches, you get what you pay for
Romantic in the evening when the harbor lights come on

name: Hama Sushi
description: Very casual conveyor belt sushi place with a calm atmosphere
reviews: Perfect quick stop before catching a train, grabbed 6 plates in 15 minutes
Surprisingly calm for a conveyor belt place, not hectic at all
Great value, each plate is only a couple bucks and the quality is solid
Fun for kids, they love watching the plates go around and picking their own
The salmon and tuna nigiri are always fresh, I come here twice a week
Nothing fancy but consistently good, my go-to casual lunch spot
Touch screen ordering is easy, food arrives fast on the belt

name: Seoul Kitchen BBQ
description: Tabletop Korean BBQ with banchan spread and soju bar
reviews: Grilling your own meat at the table is so fun, great for a group hangout
The banchan spread is generous, like 8 little dishes before you even start
Pork belly was perfectly marbled, melts in your mouth on the grill
Gets smoky inside but they have good ventilation at each table
The soju cocktails are dangerously good, we stayed way too long
Staff is super patient explaining how to grill if you've never done it
Late night hours are great, open until midnight on weekends

name: Café Mirabelle
description: Charming French café with pastries, crêpes, and light lunch
reviews: The croissants are flaky perfection, best I've had outside Paris
Such a cute little café, feels like stepping into a Parisian side street
Perfect for a quiet morning coffee and reading a book
The croque monsieur is simple but done perfectly
They have a beautiful little terrace out front with flower boxes
Not a full dinner spot, more for breakfast, brunch, or a light lunch
The hot chocolate is thick and rich, European style not American

name: Ember & Oak Steakhouse
description: Classic upscale steakhouse with dark wood interior and whiskey bar
reviews: The 16oz ribeye was cooked to a perfect medium rare, incredible sear
Very old-school steakhouse vibe, dark leather booths and dim lighting
Great for a business dinner, feels professional and impressive
The whiskey selection is massive, over 200 bottles behind the bar
Sides are a la carte and expensive but the creamed spinach is a must
Service is formal and polished, they remember your name
Not the place for a casual night out, it's a proper occasion restaurant

name: Pho Saigon Express
description: Family-run pho shop with 20+ broth variations and banh mi
reviews: The broth has been simmering for hours, you can taste the depth
Best pho in the area by far, nothing else even comes close
Super fast service, food comes out in like 5 minutes
The banh mi is stuffed and crispy, great deal for 7 bucks
Small and no-frills but spotlessly clean
My go-to comfort food spot when it's cold or rainy outside
The spicy beef pho with extra tendon is my regular order

name: Rooftop Social
description: Open-air rooftop bar and restaurant with city skyline views
reviews: The sunset views from the rooftop are absolutely stunning
Great mezze platter to share, hummus and baba ganoush were both excellent
More of a scene than a serious food place, but the vibe is unbeatable
Perfect for drinks and small plates with friends on a warm evening
Gets packed on weekends, definitely make a reservation
Music is chill lounge vibes, not too loud to talk
The grilled lamb skewers are the best thing on the menu

name: Abuela's Empanadas
description: Tiny empanada counter with rotating daily flavors
reviews: The beef empanadas are the best I've had outside of Buenos Aires
They rotate flavors daily which keeps it interesting, always something new
Super quick, perfect for grabbing lunch on the go
The chimichurri sauce they give you on the side is incredible
Tiny place with only 3 stools but the food makes up for it
Really affordable, you can get a full lunch for under 10 dollars
The sweet corn and cheese empanada was an unexpected favorite

name: The Greenhouse
description: Plant-based restaurant with industrial-greenhouse interior full of hanging plants
reviews: Even as a non-vegan I was impressed, the mushroom burger was incredible
The interior is beautiful, plants everywhere and lots of natural light
Great smoothie and juice bar in addition to the full menu
Perfect for a healthy lunch that actually tastes good
The cauliflower wings are addictive, we ordered a second round
Very chill and relaxed atmosphere, good for working on your laptop
My vegan friends say this is the only place that doesn't feel like a compromise

name: Niko's Taverna
description: Lively Greek restaurant with live bouzouki music on weekends
reviews: The grilled octopus is the best appetizer I've ever had, so tender
Live music on Saturday nights makes it feel like a real Greek taverna
Great for big groups, they push tables together and make it work
The lamb chops are perfectly seasoned, simple but incredible
Ouzo shots with the owner if you stay late enough, such a character
Lively and loud in the best way, don't come here for a quiet meal
The baklava is made by Niko's mother, recipe hasn't changed in 40 years

name: Midnight Ramen
description: Late-night ramen bar with counter seating and moody lighting
reviews: The tonkotsu broth is incredibly rich, they simmer it for 18 hours
Perfect late-night spot after drinks, exactly what you need at 1am
The spicy miso ramen with extra chashu is life-changing
Tiny place with just counter seats, feels very authentic and cozy
Soft lighting and hip-hop playing low, great atmosphere
They do a garlic bomb add-on that's not for the faint of heart
One of the few quality food spots open past midnight

name: La Terrazza
description: Upscale Italian with panoramic terrace overlooking the valley
reviews: The terrace view at sunset is breathtaking, absolutely worth the drive up the hill
Their fresh pasta rivals what I had in Florence, the truffle tagliatelle especially
Wine list is extensive and well-curated, heavy on Tuscan and Piedmont selections
Perfect for a romantic dinner, we got engaged here
The osso buco is a showstopper, fall-off-the-bone tender
Service is warm and personal, the owner comes by every table
Not cheap but not crazy expensive for the quality and experience
